programme.title: World Poker Tour: WPT Tournament Of Champions - PT1
programme.desc: World Poker Tour ignited the global poker boom with a unique television show based on a series of high-stakes tournaments. WPT events turned Gus Hansen into the Great Dane and Daniel Negreanu into Kid Poker, and created dozens of poker-made millionaires.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye flåde fra Commonwealth tager kampen op mod Drago-Kazov-flåden, men finder den meget større end forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-æggene i Harper er begyndt at klække, så holdet bygger en Tesseract-maskine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtager en turistbåd i et forsøg på at undslippe lejesoldaterne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle mine synder skal huskes
programme.desc: En identifikation af et lig går galt, da det viser sig, at Bekas tidligere besætningsmedlem ikke er død.

programme.title: Andromeda: Enfluernes dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drivkraft, men de bliver snart til zombier, der styres af et hive-mind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himlen er der nu tre
programme.desc: Skaberens motor er i stand til at omskrive universet efter ejerens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må få fat i den, før nogen med mørke planer får fat i den.
programme.sub-title: I himlen er der nu tre

programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er fastgjort
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr bliver overtaget af energien fra en dimensionstunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem, før de ødelægger skibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts
programme.desc: The prime suspect had a criminal record and his driver's license was found at the scene of a brutal double homicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Capitol Crimes
programme.desc: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: IFISH: Carp on Fly - Wyangala Dam, NSW

programme.title: IFISH: Mulloway - Botany Bay, NSW

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren bliver ringet op af en ekskæreste. Heidi konkurrerer med sin kollega Elodie om at blive forfremmet på arbejdet.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens følelser for Jason blusser op, men da de løber ind i Heidi og Spencer på en restaurant går bølgerne højt. Heidis forfremmelse hos Bolthouse koster hendes venskab med Elodie.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren bliver chokeret da hun hører, at Jason har en kæreste, men Jason har en endnu større overraskelse oppe i ærmet. Heidi finder ud af at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine forældre om deres bryllupsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Hele slænget fejrer Brodys fødselsdag i Vegas. Audrinas kæreste Justin skaber splid i venskabet med Lauren. Lauren og Brodys tiltrækkes mere og mere af hinanden.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around

programme.title: The Hills: Young Hollywood

programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren skændes endnu engang offentligt, hvilket får Heidi til at undskylde for alt det, der er sket. Og der er problemer i Audrina og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leger Kirsten Giftekniv, da Whitney skal ud på sin første date med deres personlige træner. Og Spencer modsætter sig Heidis ønsker om et eventyrbryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina ser Justin kysse med en anden pige, hvilket fører til endnu et kæmpeskænderi. Heidi er chokeret, da Stephanie skændes med Lauren og Brody på en natklub.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Da Lauren inviterer Stephanie til hendes fødselsdag, får det Heidi og Spencer til at tvivle på Stephanies loyalitet. Spencer forsøger at vinde Heidi tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Un-Bear-Able

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: How to Keep a Man 101

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak

programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: Der er tårer, da Shelby afslutter sin kærlighedstrekant. John prøver at nærme sig Christina, men bliver blokeret af Brandon, hendes ikke-match. Teamet bliver chokeret da de hører, at der er en jomfru blandt dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: En fuld kikser kan splitte det stærkeste par i huset. Anthony bager heftigt på Laytons forelskelse, Jenni. John prøver endelig lykken med Christina. Parceremonien gør huset helt rundt på gulvet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hele sæsonens hemmeligheder, drama og uafklarede affærer kommer frem i lyset i dette genforeningsafsnit, hvor de medvirkende skiftes til at sidde i den varme stol.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærlighed og vinde 1 million dollar. Deres kærlighed ved første blik-instinkter bliver sat på prøve med 250.000 ekstra på spil. En kærlighedstrekant fører til en pinlig parceremoni.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Legend: Director's Cut
programme.desc: I en eventyrskov med feer, nisser, enhjørninger ogdødelige bor også den mystiske skovbo, derer udset til at redde den smukke prinsesse ogbesejre mørkets onde fyrste…

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas - Til Jackpot Os Skiller
programme.desc: Jack (Ashton Kutcher) og Joy (Cameron Diaz) vågner op og opdager, at de er blevet gift! I stedet for annullering idømmes de ½ års ægteskab, da Jack vinder 3 mio. med Joys penge. De vil gøre alt for at snyde hinanden, men kærlighed vinder mod alle odds.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: Fra John Travoltas fængslende og Oscarnominerede præstation til Bee Gees succes-soundtrack og de uforglemmelige dansetrin - "Saturday Night Fever" er en filmsensation, der fangede verdens opmærksomhed som aldrig før.

programme.title: Rob Roy
programme.desc: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange battle evil landowners among the breathtaking landscapes of the majestic Scottish Highlands in this riveting adventure of courage, love and uncompromising honor.

programme.title: The Duellists
programme.desc: Keith Carradine og Harvey Keitel spiller med i denne dramatiske film om to officerer i Napoleons hær, der konfronterer hinanden i en række dueller.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: I jagten på en undsluppet fange går agent malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) undercover som en overdimensioneret, overmodig sydstatsmormor med en holdning så hård som hendes svinekoteletter!

programme.title: Big Mommas House 2
programme.desc: FBI agenten Malcolm Turner (Lawrence) har nu skrivebordsjob, kone ogventer barn. Men da nationens sikkerhed står på spil, må Turner somBig Momma agere barnepige for tre møgunger.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Sådan far sådan son
programme.desc: FBI-agent Malcolm Turner og hans stedsønbliver vidne til et mord og går under jorden påen scenekunstskole for piger.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: En tidligere marinesoldat går under dække som lærervikar og opdager, at en bande terroriserer highschoolen. Da liv bliver truet, sætter han sig for at rydde op på den kriminelle skole.

programme.title: The Substitute 2: Schools Out
programme.desc: I denne tilsyneladende fortsættelse er der endnu en vikarierende lærer, der tilføjer hævn til pensum; denne gang er det Williams, der træder ind i rollen og jagter medlemmerne af den ondskabsfulde bande fra New York City, som dræbte hans bror.

programme.title: Crossworlds
programme.desc: En ung mand befinder sig midt i en universel kamp mellem godt og ondt, da han slår sig ned i en transdimensional dal. Kun hans fars gådefulde krystalvedhæng og det tilhørende scepter kan sikre sejren.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: En dusørjæger bliver den jagede i en kamp om overlevelse, hvor der er meget på spil. WWE-superstjernen Randy Orton og Eric Roberts spiller hovedrollerne i denne eksplosive opfølger til The Condemned.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Den nøgterne hjerneforsker Julias forskning i, hvordan kvindens og mandens hjerne fungerer. Julias ellers så urokkelige holdninger bliver udfordret, da en flot, ny forsøgsperson melder sig til hendes forsøg.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush er baseret på Bill Keenans komiske erindringer af samme navn. Den amerikanske ishockeyspiller Bobby Sanders fra Harvard’s hockeyteam bliver byttet til en svensk 1. div. klub for en vaske-tørremaskine.

programme.title: After the Lethargy
programme.desc: Journalisten Sara rejser til et sted, hvor der siges at være rumvæsener. Hun og hendes guide bliver angrebet og tvunget til at søge ly i et forladt militæranlæg dybt inde i urskoven.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Næsten 20 år efter, at TV-kultserien Galaxy Quest blev stoppet, beder en race af rumvæsner holdet fra serien om hjælp til at redde universet.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: To af de seks seriøst mentalt forstyrrede forfattere bag gyserparodien SCARY MOVIE har igen haft nallerne i klemme i stavepladerne ogbarslet med en film, der én gang for alle pander de …

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjæle finder kærlighed og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortælling om kunst, skæve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Mystery on Twin Peaks Drive
programme.desc: A report on the December 16, 1998 death of Ronda Reynolds, whose husband found her lifeless body with a gunshot wound to the head in her home on Twin Peaks Drive in Toledo, Washington.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.
programme.sub-title: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case

programme.title: COPS: Safe Cracking
programme.desc: A man stages a sit-in in his car in an attempt to stop it from being towed. A homeowner denies that he's selling drugs despite the large amount of evidence found in his home.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Turnbull
programme.desc: She was a typical teenager. In 15 minutes she went from living an ordinary life to becoming a quadriplegic. Her name is Barbara Turnbull and she was shot in a Mississauga convenience store in a senseless robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Triple Murders in Vise
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Bad Bet
programme.desc: A bookie comes under suspicion when his wife is killed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: 3 Horrifying Cases of Ghosts and Demons
programme.desc: Join Ryan and Shane as they cover multiple cases and visit some of the most haunted places in the world.
programme.sub-title: 3 Horrifying Cases of Ghosts and Demons

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Stalked: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: Some stalkers become obsessed with people they do not know. Includes the story of serial stalker Justin Massler who was arrested for stalking Ivanka Trump, and previously targeted the Kardashian family.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clutch of Witnesses
programme.desc: Two eyewitnesses may hold the key to the death of a motorcycle gang member.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: In this episode, we look at the stories of two women who were convicted of murdering their mothers.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Drawn to Murder - Part 1
programme.desc: A two-part report on the February 1987 murder of 37-year-old Peggy Hettrick in Fort Collins, Colorado. Her mutilated, half-naked body was discovered in a field near the home of Tim Masters, a 15-year-old who lived near the crime scene.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Missing Marsha
programme.desc: A report on the 2009 disappearance of Marsha Brantley, who suddenly vanished, with no one, including her husband, Donne Brantley, family, or friends reporting her missing for several months.

programme.title: COPS: Pass the Rock
programme.desc: A police pursuit of a truck leaving a known drug location ends in a crash, undercover officers move in for a drug bust, and a man recklessly fires his handgun in the street.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: A report on the disappearance of Jeanette Louise Zapata, who mysteriously vanished without a trace from her home in Wisconsin on October 11, 1976, leaving behind her daughter Linda, and two other children.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Frontline Policing
programme.desc: This is the “meat and potatoes” of policing. Follow members of the RCMP as they police Canada’s frontlines.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: The Black Widow is a tale of classic Victorian murder. Cotton travelled around England marrying lonely men got them to take out life insurance and then murdered them.

programme.title: On the Case: The River's Edge
programme.desc: When seventeen year old high school student Stacey Fairchild disappears from a mall parking lot in Lancaster Ohio, police wonder if she ran away, was kidnapped for ransom or the victim of senseless murder.

programme.title: South Park: Overlogging
programme.desc: Der opstår forvirring og panik, da South Park opdager, at internettet er forsvundet!

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Tilbageblik
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbage og denne gang har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Broadway bro-down
programme.desc: Da Randy lærer hemmeligheden bag musicals at kende kan han ikke lade være med at tage Sharon med til at se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber og Elton John advarer ham om ikke at afsløre deres hemmelighed.

programme.title: South Park: Korrekt kondombrug
programme.desc: Takket være Stans 'håndarbejde' må børnene i South Park udholde sexundervisning fra den usandsynlige duo Mr. Mackey og Ms. Choksondik.

programme.title: South Park: Omvendt cowgirl
programme.desc: Clyde glemmer at slå toiletbrættet ned, med tragiske konsekvenser: Hans mor dør! Tragedien resulterer i ny lovgivning for toiletbrug. Stan overbeviser Clyde om, at han skal sagsøge opfinderen af toilettet.

programme.title: South Park: Freak Strike
programme.desc: Drengene tilmelder Butters som gæst i et populært talkshow, hvor folk med deformiteter medvirker.

programme.title: South Park: Tøsen
programme.desc: Ifølge Eric Cartman er Wendy Testaburger blevet lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Bætyve
programme.desc: Kyles mor får en fækal transplantation, og drengene er på jagt efter den bedste mikrobiom.

programme.title: South Park: Skøgejagt
programme.desc: Det lykkes Kyles far at skjule, at han er en internettrold samtidig med, at han spreder sine grovheder globalt.

programme.title: South Park: Spis, bed, queef
programme.desc: Mændene i South Park er frastødt af den nye kvindedille 'queefing' og prøver at få den forbudt.

programme.title: South Park: Femlinger 2000
programme.desc: Medierne viser en overvældende interesse for en familie med femlinger, som flytter til South Park, og Catman bliver gode venner med en af dem. Kennys mor forsøger at tjene penge ved at planlægge sin egen fødsel af flere børn.

programme.title: South Park: Åh, nej
programme.desc: Gerald står ansigt til ansigt med Troll-jægeren.

programme.title: South Park: Kodage
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park er overbeviste om, at et par, der har vundet en ferie i South Park, har stjålet deres mindesmærke 'Cow Days'. Faktisk er det køerne, der har flyttet den.

programme.title: South Park: T.M.I.
programme.desc: Efter en pinlig situation, der involverer visse kropsdele, bliver Cartman send til et kursus i vredeskontrol og Randy gør hvad han kan for at tage sig af efterdønningerne.

programme.title: South Park: Det fattige barn
programme.desc: Kennys forældre bliver anholdt og han kommer i pleje - så nu er Cartman det fattigste barn på skolen! Og en mystisk, maskeret figur fra fortiden vender tilbage.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Stan får en Okama Gamesphere, og drengene er fascinerede af den. Mens de spiller, kommer et talende håndklæde ved navn Towelie og taler med dem.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbitten
programme.desc: Wendy forsøger at føre en af sine veninder sammen med Butters, men ender på skolevejlederens kontor.

programme.title: South Park: Fede røv og pandekagehoved
programme.desc: Cartman laver en J-lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement for kulturel mangfoldighed, der hylder latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Efter at have undladt at læse det med småt i sin kontrakt bliver Kyle kidnappet af Apple,der har store planer for ham. Det er op til drengene at redde ham.

programme.title: South Park: Crème Fraiche
programme.desc: Irriteret over Randys perverse besættelse af madlavningsprogrammer, søger Stan Gordon Ramseys hjælp. Jamie Oliver er ikke lige så hjælpsom.

programme.title: South Park: SUPER HÅRD politisk korrekthed
programme.desc: Det har aldrig været mere udfordrende at være en PK-rektor.

programme.title: South Park: Utroligt og modigt
programme.desc: Drenge viser Caitlyn Jenner deres enorme respekt i det mest fantastiske og modige 'South Park'-afsnit nogensinde.

programme.title: South Park: Fedelejr
programme.desc: Mrs. Cartman vil gøre noget for afhjælpe sin søns spiseproblem og sender ham på en lejr for fede børn.

programme.title: South Park: Sikkert (del 2)
programme.desc: I en krise beder Satan Gud om råd, og Cartman afsløres som en bedrager. Som straf bliver han sendt til Mexico.

programme.title: South Park: Grundskolemusical
programme.desc: Da musical-galskaben, hvor alle skal danse og synge, rammer South Park, må drengene gå med på den eller opgive deres popularitet.

programme.title: South Park: Angående i aftes
programme.desc: En ny præsident er blevet valgt og beboerne i South Park fejrer det i gaderne. Mens hele landet fester, overrasker den nye præsidenten alle da han ankommer til Det Hvide Hus alt for tidllig.

programme.title: South Park: Supersjov
programme.desc: South Park Elementary har sendt Mr. Garrisons klasse på skoleudflugt til Pioneer Village, en historisk by hvor alle de ansatte lader som om det er 1864.

programme.title: South Park: Seksuel healing
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinder sig midt blandt Amerikas superkendisser, når de bliver behandlet for sexafhængighed. Cartman og Stan er klistret til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan og Kyle er klar til det store gennembrud med deres evner på computerspillet Guitar Hero. Deres manager overbeviser Stan om, at Kyle holder ham tilbage, hvilket skaber spændinger.

programme.title: South Park: Fjerde klasse
programme.desc: Ungerne bliver nødt til at starte i 4. klasse, og det er de ikke alt for glade for.

programme.title: South Park: Medicinsk stegt kylling
programme.desc: Cartman bliver rasende, når han finder ud af, at hans yndlingsrestaurant er lavet om til en medicinsk marihuana-udlevering. Randy er ikke lige så skuffet.

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiske påskespecial
programme.desc: Stan prøver at finde ud af grunden til malede påskeæg og opdager en hemmelighed om den katolske kirke.

programme.title: South Park: Toms plastikoperation
programme.desc: Drengene prøver at blive lesbiske for at gøre indtryk på en lærer.I mellemtiden får Mr. Garrisons plastikkirurgi ham, til hans store fornøjelse, til at ligne David Hasselhoff.

programme.title: South Park: Mandelproblemer
programme.desc: En sjusket blodtransfusion resulterer i, at Cartmann får AIDS. Hvor langt vil han gå for at blive kureret?

programme.title: South Park: Byens kerne
programme.desc: South Parks bykerne skal opgraderes og Kenny bestemmer sig for, at det er på tide at finde et job.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankeys juleklassikere
programme.desc: Denne special-episode giver nogle numre fra Mr. Hankeys julealbum.
